Sydney CBD & The Rocks: Iconic views from Sydney Harbour Bridge, historic laneways, and a vibrant dining scene at Circular Quay.
Newtown: Trendy boutiques, vintage shops on King Street, and a diverse range of eateries around the area.
Marrickville: Vibrant markets, quirky shops, and a dive into authentic eats along Illawarra Road.
Surry Hills: Hip cafes, bustling bars, and boutique shops line the vibrant streets of Surry Hills.
Bondi Beach: Surf culture, vibrant cafes on Campbell Parade, and the iconic Bondi to Coogee coastal walk.
Manly: Surfing, scenic coastal walks, and the bustling atmosphere of Manly Beach.
Glebe: A vibrant hub of markets, quirky boutiques, and the historic charm of Glebe Point Road.
Redfern & Eveleigh: Trendy eateries on Redfern St and vibrant markets at Carriageworks define this up-and-coming hub.
